title: REPORT on the protection of the European Union’s financial interests – combating fraud – annual report 2024
part_text: 55. Stresses that, in parallel to ongoing discussions on new own resources, efforts should also focus on enhancing fraud prevention and detection through strengthened controls, which would reduce revenue losses and ensure the recovery of funds legitimately owed to the EU and currently lost; considers that a rigorous analysis of the potential for recovering revenue currently lost due to fraud and evasion should therefore be carried out;
